description: A man in a dark suit and black hat stands in the foreground, looking to the side with a serious expression. Behind him a procession of people in white and dark uniforms marches down a street lined with two-storey wooden colonial-style balconies crowded with onlookers. A drummer in a uniform plays at the left, a red, black and green flag and a white banner with geometric patterns rise in the centre, and a few people raise their arms. The painting is loose, oil-like brushwork that fills the whole image edge to edge.
